decisions.reason: As an upgraded version of an already well-liked trommel screen, it looks like a successful continuation of an established core product rather than a short-lived launch.
The AK shredder line was still being updated to EU Stage V in 2019, which signals ongoing investment in a strategically important mobile product family.
Its move from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 suggests growing market relevance, though competition and overlap within mobile grinding products keep the risk a bit higher.
The stationary CERON pre-shredders were presented as setting benchmarks and already integrated into customer applications, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
